SHIFT NOTES — Hydraulics Folder Without Its Cover
Copy
Date: 2026-05-23
Station: DEMO-STATION-01
Program: DEMO-PROGRAM-BETA
06:50 — PERSON-0030 writes for TEAM-0006. The handover folder
reached the desk without its cover copy during preparation.
Ask the outgoing clerk to trace the copy through the station
index before assembling a fresh front sheet. Use ISSUE-0090
and TASK-0240 as locating references.
07:35 — Keep the loose hydraulics Papers together behind a
temporary divider. Add a context strip with the question,
reply destination, and next contact time. Mark the divider as
temporary so it cannot be mistaken for the recovered cover
sheet.
08:20 — The records clerk should compare the attachment
headings against the index and write any discrepancy on the
recovery note. Preserve the sequence of the papers as
received. Rearranging them before checking the index would
make the missing-copy search harder to reconstruct.
09:55 — Ask the review coordinator whether TASK-0241 is the
intended locating reference for the review appointment. Put
the reply beside the appointment request, separate from the
attachment list. A filing correction and a reviewer booking
are different desk actions.
Next-shift list
- Obtain the outgoing clerk's cover-copy search result.
- Keep the recovery note and temporary divider with the
folder.
- Confirm the review appointment's reference before moving the
